sequence: Resolve the retired getUserMedia request with a simulated stream
confirmedRegression.impact: The client retains a muted, unstopped microphone track after the talkie is extinguished. This simulated reproduction establishes neither the physical device state nor voice transmission.

passed: returned track stopped while playback remains enabled

cases.after: passed: old stream stopped; new microphone and PTT remain active

limitations: All new capture and permission scenarios use simulated browser APIs; no physical microphone permission was requested.
No end-to-end voice, physical headset, latency, real TURN relay or new browser ICE connectivity was validated.
No GPU rendering or gameplay image was validated.
These tests exercise RadioClient; they do not validate the React interface pending-state integration.
Builds and portable archives for version 0.2.1 require separate final delivery checks.
